_description: Legacy: 500 MHz, 64 FFT, two links on two channels (original bench roles)
_comment: Two-channel decoupled, SHARED pilot slot: BS(.21) rx=AB (ch0=ADC_D, ch1=ADC_C); UE(.22) tx=AB fires BOTH pilots in slot 2. Cables are spatially orthogonal (.22 DAC_B->.21 ADC_D=ch0, .22 DAC_A->.21 ADC_C=ch1) so the BS separates the two links in space -- no time-orthogonal slots needed; each RX antenna gets one clean pilot.
_ue_tdd_pilot_note: UE streams its pilot with the tdd=1 TX stream arg: the driver's TxTickAnchor accepts beacon-referenced starts on the 3.125 us (384-tick) TDD grid (SH-248/SH-301). ue_tx_advance_ticks is QUANTIZED to that grid (values under 192 vanish; leave 0). Fine seating comes from the zero-padded burst; tx_advance=247 is the bench calibration (DEMO_VERIFICATION.md 4.48).
_bs_hw_framer_note: true selects the BS native-Houdini TDD framer: one TDD symbol per sounder slot (4096 ticks), the beacon strobe on the B slot and the rx gate on every other slot; the pilot and data slots are cut from one continuous read (DEMO_VERIFICATION.md 4.12/4.16). samps_per_slot must stay <= 4096 (FPGA TX_RAM depth, else genPilots' size_t remain_size underflows): 48 x 80 + 128 + 128 = 4096.
_corr_scale_init_note: Acquisition-only detection threshold; SMALLER is STRICTER (test: corr_scale * peak > trailing local energy). 10 puts the bar at 0.1, between the populations measured on the legacy link (no beacon 3.4e-07, beacon 0.31 to 4.2), where 100 let sidelobes cross first. Acquisition also requires the 30 dB in-window SNR floor (sync.confirm.snr_floor_db) and two grid-consistent confirms, which is what rejects the noise-artifact class (DEMO_VERIFICATION.md 4.25/4.32). Re-sync uses corr_scale and relaxes per retry, gated by the same floor.
